#include "ara/per/file_storage.h"
Description:
Opens a file of the file storage for reading and writing. The file is opened as configured by
PersistencyFileProxyInterface.category or, if that is not configured, as text (corresponding to k
Text), and with the seek position set to the beginning (corresponding to kAtTheBeginning). If
the file does not exist, it is created.
